answer: Audits are logged in glacier, queued in gale, and signal publishes the wait time. A farm of 108 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 88 identities per epoch. A farm of 4507 identities would post 1436 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
